liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (3 reviews): Reviewer ranks the Scarlet>Fire among the best of the 1980s, possibly of all time; Fans had awaited Scarlet/Fire for two weeks, since the Canada shows [12][16][20]
- **Hell In a Bucket** (1 review): Weir sang with convincing venom in a good opener after some fiddling around [18]
- **Dupree's Diamond Blues** (1 review): Reviewer hears unusual percussive progressions, possibly in 7/8, in this version [18]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Reviewer calls the set-closing Let It Grow hot [20]
- **Comes a Time** (1 review): The audience is remarkably silent during this song on the tape [19]

## The recordings

- **gd87-07-08.schoeps.becker.3343.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 156 min; rated 4.64/5 by 25 [1]. Said about its sound: The audience recording sounds very good; reviewer gives it four stars; This source is boomier and less clear than the alternate Beyers source, according to the reviewer [19][21]
- **gd1987-07-08.164877.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 19 songs; 154 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd1987-07-08.fob.unknown.1600.shnf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 153 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [7]
- **gd1987-07-08.134871.bltz.flac2496**: source not stated; 20 songs; 155 min [2]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Set I, Set II [1]
- The crowd was notably enthusiastic and into the performance throughout the night [14]
- Ticketron began selling tickets about a month early by mistake; a Lynchburg fan got front row center [15]
- For this reviewer, who had listened to the band since 1980, this was a first live show [15]
- Fans crowded the area hunting for tickets; the weather was hot and many looked a bit baked [16]
- The venue felt very small, comparable to Winterland [17]
- It seemed like everyone in the crowd was tripping [23]
- At the Days Inn motel, an all-night party included an uptight security guard and a dog jumping in the pool [23]
- Reviewer finds the Scarlet>Fire strong but outside their top ten, citing many better versions [14]
- Reviewer calls the closing stretch one of the best the band pulled off in the 1980s [19]
- Reviewer counts this show and the Toronto show as the tour's highlights [20]
- Reviewer says 1987 wasn't the jammiest year, yet this show demonstrates its strength, with concise, well-played music [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd87-07-08.schoeps.becker.3343.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by PCM-M1 > Oade Active Cable > Sek'd Prodif Plus > Samplitude v5.5 > CDWAV by Don Becker; source: FOB Schoeps > PCM [1]. Also: Taped from the front of the board with Schoeps microphones, recorded through a PCM-M1 onto DAT at 44.1 kHz [1]
- **gd1987-07-08.164877.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME80 mics > Sony D5M [5]. Also: A 23-second patch in Drums comes from a Schoeps CMC4 MK4 source, via Weber-Small and Hillwig [5]
- **gd1987-07-08.fob.unknown.1600.shnf**: source: FOB ->DAT [7]. Also: Front-of-board source passed along by a friend to the uploader, who did not tape it; labeled Donbean [7]
- **gd1987-07-08.134871.bltz.flac2496**: taped by bltz; transferred by bltz; source: Source: Nakamichi CM-300s/2-Mic CP-4 super-directional shotgun capsule -> Sony Walkman Pro/Maxell XLII-S 90 -> JVC TD-W354 -> Zoom H6 96/24 WAV -> Audacity ->… [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1987-07-08 Wed Roanoke Civic Center, Roanoke, VA](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1279880246278/grateful-dead-1987-07-08-wed-roanoke) [25]

facts.lineage: The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby Decoded on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions). FLAC'd using Audiofile Engineering Sample Manager.
facts.source: 2 Nakamichi CM100s/CP4>Sony TCD5M w/Dolby Maxell MX90s cassettes. 5th row behind Board, DFC (Sec LT5 Row E Seat 5)
